ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels; estimated ratio of 15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark background with a high-contrast localized cluster of white/tan pixels on the distal right tip; stochastic high-intensity white points (specks) scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude indentation located on the inner-half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the central region transitioning into a sharp upward hook at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast pixel cluster at the extreme right tip; scattered individual white circular points on the central-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the left lobe surface, trending diagonally from upper-left to lower-right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified growth or barnacle colonization on the distal right tip; vertical and diagonal rake marks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Transient high-intensity pixel noise (water spray/splashing) obscuring the lower central fluke boundary and peduncle connection.
